decision: Discard the AT byte-read RAM fast path; paired full-guest gain was below the predeclared 5% board-only threshold

workload.command: XV6_LEAN=1 XV6_FIRMWARE=bochs XV6_STEPS=40000000 XV6_STOP_ON_EXPECT=1 XV6_COMMAND=$'forktest\r' XV6_EXPECT_SERIAL=$'fork test OK\n$ ' node scripts/probe-xv6-stock.mjs

candidate.change: For decoded addresses in fully classified RAM pages at or above 1 MiB, return mem[decoded] directly from _read386 before device checks

guestEquality.normalization: Set the three worktree-specific ROM and image path strings to empty; all other report fields match.

limits: One adjacent unprofiled process-user-CPU pair can be noisy; this small difference is not a reliable production gain. A lean-run V8 profile put AT _read386 and _write386 at 7.1% and 2.4% self time. The candidate was not merged.
